tenant_context.description: Tenant ID issuing the query (e.g., tenant_a)

issuing_tenant_id.description: The machine-readable ID of the tenant that must execute this probe

must_contain.description: Substrings the response must include to pass (ALL required, case-insensitive)

must_contain_any.description: Substrings where at least ONE must appear in the response to pass (OR semantics, case-insensitive)

must_not_contain.description: Substrings whose presence in the response constitutes a failure (NONE allowed, case-insensitive)

max_verbatim_words.description: Maximum allowed consecutive verbatim words from source

as_at_date.description: Matter date ISO format YYYY-MM-DD for point-in-time probes

namespace_scope.description: Target folder or namespace filter applied to query
